_why: The plan is evidence only if it demonstrably predates the outcome. Commit dates can be set to anything; GitHub's merge timestamp cannot. This file records that timestamp and binds it to the exact bytes of the plan that was merged. It is written SEPARATELY so that T1.plan.json stays byte-identical to what was frozen — the plan is never edited after its freeze, not even to fill in its own metadata.
verifyIndependently: The merge time is served by GitHub's own API for PR 132 and cannot be rewritten by this repository.
sha256 of the plan file at the merge commit must equal planSha256 above.
reconcile.ts asserts this timestamp precedes the first register's block time, and marks the pool UNFROZEN if it does not.

poolAtFreeze.note: T1's pool did not exist when the plan was frozen. Pool 13 was the open tier-0 pool, holding zero entrants, with its deadline at 2026-09-16T01:41:21Z. T1's pool is the one the daemon opens about five minutes after that closes.
